description: agentops/collector.yaml defines metrics + logs pipelines and a file exporter
command: [ -f agentops/collector.yaml ] && yq -e '.service.pipelines.metrics and .service.pipelines.logs and .exporters.file' agentops/collector.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: agentops/ledger.py exists and parses claude_code.api_request into model/cost/tokens
command: [ -f agentops/ledger.py ] && grep -q 'claude_code.api_request' agentops/ledger.py && grep -q 'cost_usd' agentops/ledger.py && grep -q 'input_tokens' agentops/ledger.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: agentops/budget-check.sh exists and exits non-zero on an over-budget run
command: [ -f agentops/budget-check.sh ] && grep -q 'BUDGET ALERT' agentops/budget-check.sh && grep -Eq 'exit 1' agentops/budget-check.sh && echo pass || echo fail

description: ledger.py emits a valid JSON row (model + cost_usd + input_tokens keys) from a synthetic api_request telemetry line
command: T=$(mktemp); printf '{"resourceLogs":[{"scopeLogs":[{"logRecords":[{"body":{"stringValue":"claude_code.api_request"},"attributes":[{"key":"session.id","value":{"stringValue":"abc123de"}},{"key":"model","value":{"stringValue":"claude-sonnet-5"}},{"key":"input_tokens","value":{"intValue":"16000"}},{"key":"output_tokens","value":{"intValue":"40"}},{"key":"cost_usd","value":{"doubleValue":0.11}},{"key":"duration_ms","value":{"intValue":"2000"}},{"key":"effort","value":{"stringValue":"high"}}]}]}]}]}\n' > "$T"; python3 agentops/ledger.py "$T" check | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["model"]=="claude-sonnet-5" and r["input_tokens"]==16000 and r["cost_usd"]==0.11' && rm -f "$T" && echo pass || { rm -f "$T"; echo fail; }

description: budget-check.sh flags a run over the token budget and exits non-zero
command: T=$(mktemp); printf '{"resourceLogs":[{"scopeLogs":[{"logRecords":[{"body":{"stringValue":"claude_code.api_request"},"attributes":[{"key":"model","value":{"stringValue":"claude-sonnet-5"}},{"key":"input_tokens","value":{"intValue":"16000"}},{"key":"output_tokens","value":{"intValue":"40"}},{"key":"cost_usd","value":{"doubleValue":0.11}},{"key":"duration_ms","value":{"intValue":"2000"}}]}]}]}]}\n' > "$T"; if ./agentops/budget-check.sh "$T" 1000 >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$T"; echo fail; else rm -f "$T"; echo pass; fi

description: YOUR FIX: the ledger counts cache_read and cache_creation tokens — a row that sums only input+output under-reports a real run by two orders of magnitude and inverts the model ranking
command: T=$(mktemp); printf '{"resourceLogs":[{"scopeLogs":[{"logRecords":[{"body":{"stringValue":"claude_code.api_request"},"attributes":[{"key":"model","value":{"stringValue":"claude-sonnet-5"}},{"key":"input_tokens","value":{"intValue":"10"}},{"key":"output_tokens","value":{"intValue":"20"}},{"key":"cache_read_tokens","value":{"intValue":"5000"}},{"key":"cache_creation_tokens","value":{"intValue":"1000"}},{"key":"cost_usd","value":{"doubleValue":0.11}},{"key":"duration_ms","value":{"intValue":"2000"}}]}]}]}]}\n' > "$T"; python3 agentops/ledger.py "$T" cache | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["total_tokens"]==6030, r.get("total_tokens")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { rm -f "$T"; echo pass; } || { rm -f "$T"; echo fail; }

description: YOUR FIX: budget-check.sh exits non-zero when it cannot evaluate — called with no arguments it must refuse, not report a pass a CI stage would read as within budget
command: [ -x agentops/budget-check.sh ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; if ./agentops/budget-check.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo fail; else echo pass; fi
